== Title ==
<span lang="ja">レイア・シーカー</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォース使用して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォース消費して移動させることができる。レイアまたは能力値＜3の戦士と同じ場所についたら、そのうち1枚を選んで、ロストさせる。その際レイア・シーカーもロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Leia Seeker]].

'''Lore''' — Military remote. It is programmed to track a specified person or a specified condition. Heat-optical sensors track the target with high accuracy. It can also be slipped onto a starship.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force to deploy on the opponent side of an unexplored location card. During your control phase, you may move it like a character by spending Force. If it is at the same location as Leia or a warrior of ability less than 3, choose one of them to be lost. Leia Seeker is also lost.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese deploys on the opponent side of an unexplored location card (未踏査). English deploys on opponent's side at any unoccupied site. Lore tracks a specified person or condition, not secondary targets.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-leiaseeker-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Leia Seeker]].</ref>
